Model post processing

Author

Fabian Arntz

Published

July 11, 2024

false
Code 
function row_diff(a)
   b = similar(a)
   b[1,:] .= 0
   for i in 2:size(a,1)
         b[i,:] .= a[i,:] .- a[i-1,:] 
   end
   return b 
end

function lrt_table(nms,mods,lrt)
   DataFrame(;
      name = nms, 
      dof=dof.(mods),
      deviance=deviance.(mods),
      AIC=aic.(mods),
      AIC_dif=row_diff(aic.(mods)),
      AICc=aicc.(mods),
      BIC=bic.(mods),
      BIC_dif=row_diff(bic.(mods)),
      χ²=vcat(:., round.(lrt.tests.deviancediff, digits=3)),
      χ²_dof=vcat(:., round.(lrt.tests.dofdiff, digits=3)),
      pvalue=vcat(:., round.(lrt.tests.pvalues, digits=3)),
      ) 
end

function mpar_table(nms,mods)
   df = DataFrame(;
      name = nms, 
      dof=dof.(mods),
      deviance=deviance.(mods),
      deviance_dif=row_diff(deviance.(mods)),
      AIC=aic.(mods),
      AIC_dif=row_diff(aic.(mods)),
      BIC=bic.(mods),
      BIC_dif=row_diff(bic.(mods)),
      )
end

function fit_loop(models, formulas, data)
   df = DataFrame()
   for i=1:length(models)
   global m = fit(MixedModel, formulas[i], data, contrasts=contr);
   df = append!(df,DataFrame(models = models[i], singular = issingular(m)));
   @eval $(Symbol(models[i])) = deepcopy(m);
   end
   return df
end

function fit_loop_save(models, formulas, data, location)
   df = DataFrame()
   for i=1:length(models)
   global m = fit(MixedModel, formulas[i], data; contrasts=contr);
   saveoptsum(location * models[i] * ".json", m);
   df = append!(df,DataFrame(models = models[i], singular = issingular(m)));
   @eval $(Symbol(models[i])) = deepcopy(m);
   end
   return df
end


function fit_loop_load(models, formulas, data, location)
   df = DataFrame()
   for i=1:length(models)
   global m = LinearMixedModel(formulas[i], data; contrasts=contr);
   restoreoptsum!(m, location * models[i] * ".json");
   df = append!(df,DataFrame(models = models[i], singular = issingular(m)));
   @eval $(Symbol(models[i])) = deepcopy(m);
   end
   return df
end

function glmm_fit_loop(models, formulas, data)
   df = DataFrame()
   for i=1:length(models)
   global m = fit(MixedModel, formulas[i], data, dist; nAGQ, contrasts=contr);
   df = append!(df,DataFrame(models = models[i], singular = issingular(m)));
   @eval $(Symbol(models[i])) = deepcopy(m);
   end
   return df
end

function glmm_fit_loop_save(models, formulas, data, location)
   df = DataFrame()
   for i=1:length(models)
   global m = fit(MixedModel, formulas[i], data, dist; nAGQ, contrasts=contr);
   saveoptsum(location * models[i] * ".json", m);
   df = append!(df,DataFrame(models = models[i], singular = issingular(m)));
   @eval $(Symbol(models[i])) = deepcopy(m);
   end
   return df
end

function glmm_fit_loop_load(models, formulas, data, location)
   df = DataFrame()
   for i=1:length(models)
   global m = GeneralizedLinearMixedModel(formulas[i], data, dist; contrasts=contr);
   restoreoptsum!(m, location * models[i] * ".json");
   df = append!(df,DataFrame(models = models[i], singular = issingular(m)));
   @eval $(Symbol(models[i])) = deepcopy(m);
   end
   return df
end

Data = @chain DataFrame(XLSX.readtable("data/dat_analysis.xlsx", "Sheet1")) # 134,940 (old 133,675 (old 133,403))

dat1 = @chain Data begin
  select(:Subj, :alc_g, :alc_b, :alc_l, :alc_l2, :gender, :a1, :a2, :a3, :wd, :ld, :hd, :d1, :d2, :d3, :jd, :yd_sin, :yearday, :mday);
  @transform(
    :Subj = :Subj,
    :mday = real(:mday),
    :alc_g = real(:alc_g),
    :alc_l = real(:alc_l),
    :alc_l2 = real(:alc_l2),
    :alc_b = real(:alc_b),
    :gender = :gender,
    :a1 = real(:a1),
    :a2 = real(:a2),
    :a3 = real(:a3),
    :wd = :wd,
    :ld = :ld,
    :hd = :hd,
    :d1 = real(:d1),
    :d2 = real(:d2),
    :d3 = real(:d3),
    :jd = :jd,
    :yd_sin = real(:yd_sin),
    :yearday = real(:yearday))
end;


contr = Dict(
  :Subj => Grouping(),
  :gender => EffectsCoding(; levels=["woman", "man"]),
  :ld => EffectsCoding(; levels=["ld0", "ld1"]),
  :hd => EffectsCoding(; levels=["hd0", "hd1"]),
  :wd => EffectsCoding(; levels=["wd0", "wd1"]),
  :jd => HypothesisCoding(
    [
       -1  1  0  # dry january
       -1  0  1  # drinking december
    ];
    levels=["other", "January", "December"],
    labels=["dry_jan", "dri_dec"])
  );

3 drinkday frequency

glmm approach using the main model formular focusing the distribution of drinkdays versus non-drink days to assess drink days frequency (i.e. how often do people drink).

Sinus centering was determined aswell and yielded centering at day 248 (identical to the main model) [see 05_sinusloop.html].

4 lmm - drinkamount

lmm approach using the main model formular focusing the distribution of drinking amounts on drinkdays only to assess drink days frequency (i.e. how often do people drink).

Sinus centering was determined aswell and yielded centering at day 250 (two days later than the main model) [see 05_sinusloop.html].
